svg.aria-label: Diagram of the sea.c project: main.c reads a source file, sea_tokenize splits it into tokens, and a recursive-descent parser with one function per precedence level builds an ASSIGN / ADD / MUL syntax tree for x = a + b * 2.
svg.text: sea.c — from source line to syntax tree
A small C-like teaching language: tokenize up front, then recursive descent with one function per precedence level.
sea_tokens — every token produced before parsing starts
PARSER (each level calls the one below)
main.c reads the file with util.c's readFile …
… sea_tokenize splits it into tokens up front, so the parser never sees whitespace …
… and the parser walks down the precedence ladder, building a node each time it consumes a token.
Errors become nodes too, so one bad token never stops the parse.
